aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretched growth. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups, which amplifies both potential gains and drawdowns. Be aware of daily decay and rebalancing effects on leveraged ETFs, and maintain strict stop discipline.
